description: Mark up to 200 of your orders as shipped, with an optional tracking number, tracking link, and carrier applied to the whole batch. Requires sign-in with seller access. Tracking you supply replaces tracking already on those orders, and each buyer is notified.

carrier_name.description: Carrier for the shipment. Omit to infer it from tracking_number.

order_ids.description: Order ids belonging to the calling seller (max 200/request). Orders owned by anyone else are skipped.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number written to every listed order. Supplying this without carrier_name auto-detects the carrier.

tracking_url.description: Tracking URL written to every listed order.

name: bulk_mark_shipped
title: Bulk mark orders shipped
